title: feat(nm2simslx): simultaneous M and O at t+1 on two-axis same-lock x-probes: reverse HOLD, face HOLD
science: Two-axis same-lock seed, x-probes, simultaneous: hold/hold, matching the opposite seed. Its runner also reprints the nm2slx cover fail/fail and nm2slpx forall-perp hold/hold cross-checks, making it the densest single cross-reference block in the band.
